user_problem: Written instructions contain forward references, hidden prerequisites, or verification steps placed too late.
unique_output: A reordered step plan preserving original actions while exposing moves, prerequisites, and verification checkpoints.
required_input: Complete instruction steps, dependency statements, starting state, expected end state, and immutable step text.
critical_rule: Reorder only when dependencies support it; do not invent actions or silently edit immutable instructions.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is tutorial-prerequisite-mapper; this repairs sequence order rather than merely identifying prerequisite relationships.
acceptance_scenario: Input steps are submit form, enter email, confirm preview; dependency says preview follows entry and submission follows confirmation. Output orders enter, preview, submit and records both moves without changing step text.
